title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the nature and position of the image as a virtual point image 1.75 cm off the optical axis.

title: Angle Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the tangent function to calculate the height of the image based on the angle of incidence.

title: Focal Length Usage
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly utilize the focal length of the diverging lens in their calculations.

title: Sign Convention
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid errors related to the sign of the focal length for a diverging lens.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all measurements and calculations are consistent in terms of units.
